_comment: validate_uat.py config tailored to PM Agent (commit b4a2a4c). Targets the status_summary agent, which is the highest-impact surface: its output sets project.healthStatus and propagates to the Program and Executive dashboards. Add sibling configs for the requirements and artifact agents once the capture layer exists.

output_schema._comment: Mirrors the 9 fields the prompt at ai.ts:216-231 declares. assumptions and conflicts are REQUIRED here because GR-10.3 and GR-12 demand them - the schema currently omits them, which is DEF-009. Leaving them required makes the gap visible on every run instead of invisible.

grounding._comment: Numbers are the yield here, not names. Every figure the narrative states must exist in the PM Q&A or the live EVM block passed into the prompt. This is the automated form of GR-3.

cross_field_rules._comment: GR-11 HONEST STATUS, mechanised. This is the single most valuable rule in the file - it is the check that DEF-002 says the application is missing. Requires the capture layer to copy liveEVM.spi into output._observed_spi, or run it against the DB-persisted StatusReport row.
cross_field_rules.name: GR11_no_greenwash_on_spi

cross_field_rules._comment: DEF-004: cpi is not derivable from narrative PM answers. Until it is computed in code, any non-null cpi is a fabricated financial index. Flip this rule off once cpi is passed in as read-only context.
cross_field_rules.name: DEF004_cpi_must_be_null_until_computed_in_code
cross_field_rules.note: CPI = EV/AC. A model cannot derive it from free text.

cross_field_rules._comment: GR-3: where data is absent the model must mark it, not invent it. A narrative that asserts budget performance while cpi is null is asserting a fact it declared it lacks.
cross_field_rules.name: GR3_no_budget_assertion_when_cpi_null

_placeholder_note: GR-3 legitimately instructs the model to emit [ASSUMPTION: ...] and <TBD - confirm with sponsor>. Those are compliant, not defects. The bare \bTBD\b pattern above will flag them - keep it, and disposition each hit: a marked assumption is a PASS, an unmarked TBD is a defect. If the noise becomes unmanageable, replace the TBD pattern with (?<!<)\bTBD\b(?! . confirm).

hedging_patterns._comment: Hedging in metricsNarrative usually marks an inference over data the PM never supplied. Route each hit to manual claim review rather than accepting it.

stability._comment: These five fields drive executive decisions. All must be byte-identical across repeated runs of the same input. Meaningless until temperature is pinned to 0 (DEF-001).
